title: Voltage & Ohm's Law
subject: Basic Electricity
description: Spark explains what electricity actually is, and the one formula that ties voltage, current, and resistance together.

examples.prompt: A 6V battery pushes current through a 200Ω resistor. How much current flows?
3 A flows through a 10Ω resistor. What's the voltage across it?
A resistor has 5V across it and 0.5A flowing through it. What's its resistance?

quiz.prompt: On the Ohm's Law triangle, you cover V to find it. What do the two letters left uncovered tell you to do?
quiz.explain: Covering V leaves I and R side by side — side by side means multiply: V = I × R.

quiz.prompt: On the triangle, you cover I to find it. What's left uncovered, and what does it tell you?
choices: I and R, so multiply them
V over R, so divide V by R
V over I, so divide V by I
quiz.explain: Covering I leaves V stacked over R — stacked means divide: I = V ÷ R.
quiz.diagram: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 220 180" width="140" height="115"><polygon points="110,10 10,170 210,170" fill="none" stroke="var(--wood)" stroke-width="4"/><line x1="47.5" y1="110" x2="172.5" y2="110" stroke="var(--wood)" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="110" y1="110" x2="110" y2="170" stroke="var(--wood)" stroke-width="3"/><text x="110" y="80" font-size="30" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--ink)" font-family="Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif">V</text><text x="72" y="150" font-size="30" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--ink)" font-family="Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif">I</text><text x="150" y="150" font-size="30" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--ink)" font-family="Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif">R</text></svg>

quiz.prompt: A 12V battery pushes current through a 4Ω resistor. Cover I on the triangle — how much current flows?
quiz.explain: Covering I leaves V over R: I = 12 ÷ 4 = 3 A.
quiz.diagram: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 220 180" width="140" height="115"><polygon points="110,10 10,170 210,170" fill="none" stroke="var(--wood)" stroke-width="4"/><line x1="47.5" y1="110" x2="172.5" y2="110" stroke="var(--wood)" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="110" y1="110" x2="110" y2="170" stroke="var(--wood)" stroke-width="3"/><text x="110" y="80" font-size="30" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--ink)" font-family="Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif">V</text><text x="72" y="150" font-size="30" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--ink)" font-family="Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif">I</text><text x="150" y="150" font-size="30" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--ink)" font-family="Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif">R</text></svg>

quiz.prompt: 2 A flows through a 6Ω resistor. Cover V on the triangle — what's the voltage?
quiz.explain: Covering V leaves I and R side by side: V = 2 × 6 = 12 V.
quiz.diagram: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 220 180" width="140" height="115"><polygon points="110,10 10,170 210,170" fill="none" stroke="var(--wood)" stroke-width="4"/><line x1="47.5" y1="110" x2="172.5" y2="110" stroke="var(--wood)" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="110" y1="110" x2="110" y2="170" stroke="var(--wood)" stroke-width="3"/><text x="110" y="80" font-size="30" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--ink)" font-family="Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif">V</text><text x="72" y="150" font-size="30" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--ink)" font-family="Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif">I</text><text x="150" y="150" font-size="30" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--ink)" font-family="Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif">R</text></svg>

quiz.prompt: A resistor has 20V across it with 4 A flowing through it. Cover R on the triangle — what's the resistance?
quiz.explain: Covering R leaves V over I: R = 20 ÷ 4 = 5 Ω.

quiz.prompt: A 10V battery pushes current through a 2Ω resistor. Cover I on the triangle — how much current flows?
quiz.explain: Covering I leaves V over R: I = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 A.

quiz.prompt: 0.5 A flows through a 20Ω resistor. Cover V on the triangle — what's the voltage?
quiz.explain: Covering V leaves I and R side by side: V = 0.5 × 20 = 10 V.
